name: XMind
description_en:
Xmind is a mind-mapping and visual-planning application across web, desktop and mobile. It combines topic structures, presentation modes, collaboration and AI-assisted generation, with task/Gantt capabilities on eligible plans.

Online map limits, local files, export rights and AI credits are different dimensions. A trial credit grant is not the same as a monthly AI allowance.
description_zh:
Xmind 是跨网页、桌面和移动的脑图及可视化规划应用，结合主题结构、演示、协作和 AI 生成，并在相应套餐提供任务及甘特能力。

在线图数、本地文件、导出权和 AI credits 是不同维度，试用赠送额度也不等于每月 AI 额度。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize ideas as maps, timelines or other structures.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把想法组织为脑图、时间线等结构。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate or reorganize topics using a distinct credit allowance.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用独立 credits 生成或重组主题。

core_features.explanation_en: Premium includes real-time collaborative maps, task and Gantt features.
core_features.explanation_zh: Premium 包含实时协作图、任务及甘特功能。

zh: 示例：把发布计划转成脑图
use_cases.basis: Illustrative workflow and selection guidance, not observed customer outcomes.

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 限手动在线图并赠 AI 试用额；Pro/Premium 订阅，Premium 有月度 AI，试用仅年付并有续费退款条件。

Examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese text does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Mind maps, visual structures and planning
sections.en: The current site describes mind maps, timelines, matrices, presentation modes and real-time shared work. AI can draft or refine structure, while Premium planning connects topics to tasks and Gantt charts. A generated map is a starting structure, not proof that a document was completely or accurately summarized. Distinguish locally stored documents from shared online maps before setting privacy expectations.
sections.zh: 当前网站介绍脑图、时间线、矩阵、演示及实时共享。AI 可起草或整理结构，Premium 规划将主题关联任务和甘特图。生成图是初始结构，不证明文档被完整准确总结。确定隐私预期前，应区分本地文件和共享在线脑图。

sections.title_en: Example: convert a release plan into a map
sections.title_zh: 示例：把发布计划转成脑图
sections.en: Create branches for scope, risks and owners, mark unresolved assumptions and add tasks only where dates are meaningful. If AI imports a brief, compare omitted requirements and dates with the source before accepting the map. Export to the actual destination and reopen it to inspect layout and editable content. No plan, AI result or export was tested here.
sections.zh: 建立范围、风险和负责人分支，标记未决假设，仅在日期有意义处添加任务。若用 AI 导入需求，应先核对遗漏要求及日期。导出后需在实际目标工具重开，检查布局及可编辑内容。本文未测试计划、AI 或导出。

sections.title_en: Online maps and AI credits interact
sections.title_zh: 在线图数与 AI credits 相互作用
sections.en: Free allows ten manually created online maps and 50 trial AI credits; Pro raises manual maps to 50 and also lists a 50-credit trial grant. Premium has unlimited collaborative maps and 500 monthly AI credits. The pricing FAQ says valid AI credits can temporarily exempt AI-created maps from the manual map cap; after credits expire or run out, excess existing maps remain openable/deletable but new creation is blocked by the standard cap. This is not unlimited Free storage or a recurring 50-credit refill.
sections.zh: Free 允许手动创建十张在线图，赠 50 AI 试用 credits；Pro 手动图数为 50，也列 50 试用 credits。Premium 有不限协作图和每月 500 credits。FAQ 说明有效 AI credits 可让 AI 创建图暂不受手动图数限制；额度过期或用完后，超额既有图仍可打开删除，但新建受标准上限约束。这不是免费无限存储，也不是每月补 50 credits。

sections.title_en: Confirm cadence, devices and refund conditions
sections.title_zh: 确认结算周期、设备及退款条件
sections.en: The fetched page shows Pro US$4.92/month and Premium US$8.25/month with monthly/yearly selectors, so verify the selected billing cadence and full checkout total. The FAQ limits the seven-day trial to annual subscriptions, says subscriptions auto-renew and excludes monthly subscriptions and AI add-ons from its refund policy. It lists upgrade rights on five desktop and five mobile devices. Plan-specific exports and history also matter; do not infer self-hosting, unrestricted source rights or tested sync recovery.
sections.zh: 页面显示 Pro 每月 4.92 美元、Premium 8.25 美元，并有年月选择，应确认所选周期和完整结账。FAQ 把七天试用限定于年订阅，说明自动续费，并把月订阅和 AI 加购排除在退款政策之外；还列五台桌面及五台移动设备升级权。导出和历史也受套餐影响，不能推定自托管、无限源码权或已测试同步恢复。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source documentation research, original English synthesis and Chinese translation; examples are hypothetical and unexecuted.

research_gaps.en: Verify chosen checkout cadence, actual AI consumption/expiry, local-versus-cloud behavior, export fidelity and sync recovery.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认结账周期、AI 实际消耗到期、本地云行为、导出保真及同步恢复。

research_gaps.en: No live account, purchase, recovery or performance test was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未实际创建账户、购买、测试恢复或测量性能。
